name: _content.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  docs/_content.scss — the content column — %MAXAREA gutter contract; containers stay pointer-transparent so the fixed scene stays draggable.
//  Imported by docs.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.#{$_B_DOCS} {
  // ── Content column — the project's max-area gutter contract ──────────
  // The containers themselves are pointer-transparent so the fixed scene
  // behind stays draggable wherever no interactive surface covers it;
  // interactive children re-enable hit-testing explicitly.
  &-header,
  &-crumbs,
  &-body,
  &-main,
  &-grid {
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  &-header,
  &-body {
    @extend %MAXAREA;

    z-index: 1;
  }

  &-header {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-md);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
    padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-md);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 88%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  }

  &-title {
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 100;
    font-size: to-rem($space-3xl);
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }

  &-updated {
    margin-left: auto;
    align-self: flex-end;
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    opacity: 0.6;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }

  &-body {
    display: grid;
    // minmax(0,1fr): a bare 1fr track floors at min-content, so min-content
    // payloads (istanbul tables, code <pre>) would blow the column past
    // the viewport. The 0 floor lets the track shrink and defers the
    // overflow to the inner scrollports.
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: to-rem($space-xl);
    flex: 1;

    @include layout-1024() {
      grid-template-columns: to-rem($space-7xl) minmax(0, 1fr);
      align-items: start;
    }
  }

  &-main {
    // Grid items default to min-width:auto — same min-content floor —
    // release it so the viewer can shrink to the track.
    min-width: 0;
  }
}
